name: N-1 starfighter
description: The N-1 starfighter, also referred to as the Royal Naboo N-1 starfighter, Naboo N-1 starfighter, Naboo starfighter, N-1 fighter, or more simply, the N-1, was a single seat patrol craft developed by the Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps and used by the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

data.name: N-1 starfighter
data.manufacturer: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
data.countermeasures: Chromium finish on frontal hull section (temporarily dazzles optical sensors)

One proton torpedo magazine (capacity for 10 torpedoes)
